All conjuncts are already available in the proof from `weylAut_apply_h/e/f he hf t`.
findings.issue: `exists_lieEquiv_forall_mem_rootSpace` is the only ℚ-hypothesis-free statement — the intended external entry point — but its existential records nothing about τ beyond the root-space inclusion. The PR's own declared Layer 9 consumer needs both the root-space matching and `weylAut_apply_e` (the `N(α,β) = -N(-α,-β)` sign relation); the second is unavailable from this statement, forcing every consumer to redo the `letI := ratLieAlgebra K L` construction by hand.

summary: No compatibility surface and no exposed bodies, and the `weylAut` characteristic lemmas (values on h, e, f, centraliser, reflection formula) are complete. But five composite-specific computation lemmas are public with no consumer, the one unconditional normal-form lemma carries no `@[simp]`, and the ℚ-free entry point drops the triple data the declared consumer needs.
